name: undo_swap_partitioned_tables
description: Undo table swap: rename partitioned tables back to _new, restore _old tables to production names, and reverse sequence, index, and FK constraint renames
query: ALTER TABLE prow_job_runs RENAME CONSTRAINT fk_prow_job_runs_prow_job_id TO fk_prow_job_runs_new_prow_job_id; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_runs_release_timestamp RENAME TO idx_prow_job_runs_new_release_timestamp; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_runs_prow_job_id RENAME TO idx_prow_job_runs_new_prow_job_id; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_runs_timestamp RENAME TO idx_prow_job_runs_new_timestamp; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_run_annotations_release_timestamp RENAME TO idx_prow_job_run_annotations_new_release_timestamp; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_run_annotations_key RENAME TO idx_prow_job_run_annotations_new_key; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_release_timestamp RENAME TO idx_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_new_release_timestamp; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_prow_pull_request_id RENAME TO idx_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_new_prow_pull_request_id; ALTER SEQUENCE prow_job_runs_id_seq RENAME TO prow_job_runs_new_id_seq; ALTER SEQUENCE prow_job_run_annotations_id_seq RENAME TO prow_job_run_annotations_new_id_seq; ALTER TABLE prow_job_runs RENAME TO prow_job_runs_new; ALTER TABLE prow_job_run_annotations RENAME TO prow_job_run_annotations_new; ALTER TABLE prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests RENAME TO prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_new; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_runs_old_release_timestamp RENAME TO idx_prow_job_runs_release_timestamp; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_runs_old_prow_job_id RENAME TO idx_prow_job_runs_prow_job_id; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_runs_old_timestamp RENAME TO idx_prow_job_runs_timestamp; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_run_annotations_old_release_timestamp RENAME TO idx_prow_job_run_annotations_release_timestamp; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_run_annotations_old_key RENAME TO idx_prow_job_run_annotations_key; ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_old_release_timestamp RENAME TO idx_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_release_timestamp; ALTER SEQUENCE prow_job_runs_old_id_seq RENAME TO prow_job_runs_id_seq; ALTER SEQUENCE prow_job_run_annotations_old_id_seq RENAME TO prow_job_run_annotations_id_seq; ALTER TABLE prow_job_runs_old RENAME TO prow_job_runs; ALTER TABLE prow_job_run_annotations_old RENAME TO prow_job_run_annotations; ALTER TABLE prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_old RENAME TO prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests; ALTER TABLE prow_job_runs RENAME CONSTRAINT fk_prow_jobs_old_job_runs TO fk_prow_jobs_job_runs;

name: restore_foreign_keys
description: Restore FK constraints that were dropped during the original swap
query: DO $$ BEGIN ALTER TABLE prow_job_run_annotations ADD CONSTRAINT fk_prow_job_runs_annotations FOREIGN KEY (prow_job_run_id) REFERENCES prow_job_runs (id); EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN RAISE NOTICE 'FK fk_prow_job_runs_annotations already exists'; WHEN others THEN RAISE NOTICE 'Could not restore FK fk_prow_job_runs_annotations: %', SQLERRM; END $$; DO $$ BEGIN ALTER TABLE prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests ADD CONSTRAINT fk_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_prow_job_run FOREIGN KEY (prow_job_run_id) REFERENCES prow_job_runs (id); EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN RAISE NOTICE 'FK fk_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_prow_job_run already exists'; WHEN others THEN RAISE NOTICE 'Could not restore FK fk_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_prow_job_run: %', SQLERRM; END $$; DO $$ BEGIN ALTER TABLE prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests ADD CONSTRAINT fk_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_prow_pull_request FOREIGN KEY (prow_pull_request_id) REFERENCES prow_pull_requests (id); EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN RAISE NOTICE 'FK fk_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_prow_pull_request already exists'; WHEN others THEN RAISE NOTICE 'Could not restore FK fk_prow_job_run_prow_pull_requests_prow_pull_request: %', SQLERRM; END $$;
